description: Shared correctness fixtures for the four representation variants (boxedObjectGraph, flatPrimitiveArrays, packedOffHeapStruct, reusedMutableHolder) over three datasets. Representation changes bytes/instance and construction cost, never the checksum.

semantics.xorshift64: x ^= x << 13; x ^= x >>> 7 (unsigned/logical); x ^= x << 17 (64-bit wrapping, unsigned interpretation throughout)

ordersQuotes.fields: id = i (linear); priceTicks = xorshift64 stream unsigned-mod 10,000,000 + 1; quantity = xorshift64 stream unsigned-mod 10,000 + 1; flags = xorshift64 stream unsigned-mod 16 (three xorshift64 advances per record, in this order: priceTicks, quantity, flags)
ordersQuotes.checksum: wrapping sum of (id + priceTicks + quantity + flags) over all records

treeNodes.fields: value = xorshift64 stream unsigned-mod 1,000,000 (one advance per record); structure = complete binary tree, node i's children are at index 2i+1 and 2i+2 when < n
treeNodes.checksum: wrapping sum of value over all records, any traversal order (sum is order-invariant, so representation is free to traverse index-order or pointer-order)

smallTuples.fields: x = xorshift64 stream unsigned-mod 100,000; y = xorshift64 stream unsigned-mod 100,000 (two xorshift64 advances per record, in this order: x, y)
smallTuples.checksum: wrapping sum of (x + y) over all records
